title: Just the 'Facts, Part 1
description: Just the 'Facts, Part 1 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Jerome's Bones

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to Level 1 of the Shadow's Embrace. Kill Oroks until you obtain an Artifact Chest Skeleton Key, then unlock a nearby artifact chest. Bring the first artifact you find back to Jerome's bones in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Jerome's Bones

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Just the 'Facts, Part 2

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to Level 1 of the Shadow's Embrace. Kill Oroks until you obtain an Artifact Chest Skeleton Key, then unlock a nearby artifact chest. Bring the first artifact you find back to Jerome's bones in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

Kid, I gotta tell ya: It's amazin' how many secrets a skeleton will hear throughout the day. Recently, I heard one about some mystical artifacts that may help get me resurrected!

Here's the deal: There are old ruins scattered throughout Level 1 of the Shadow's Embrace. The Guild of Shadows has been using Oroks t' loot those ruins. They are storin' all the artifacts they find in nearby locked chests. It may take a while, but kill the looters 'til ya get an Artifact Chest Skeleton Key. When ya do, unlock a chest and bring me back the first artifact ya find.

Turn-in:

Ya got one! Well, here goes nothing....

...Yeah, *nothing* is right. Figgers.

Objectives:

  • Retrieve Mystical Artifact ×1

Level range: 46–100
